mapper.sql: json_build_object( 'photo_id', p.photo_id, 'work_id', p.work_id, 'kind', p.kind, 'file_name', p.file_name, 'mime_type', p.mime_type, 'file_size', p.file_size, 'reg_date', to_char(p.reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') )
mapper.select: SELECT work_id FROM map.facility_office_work WHERE work_id = #{workId} AND use_yn = 'y' FOR UPDATE
SELECT work_id FROM map.facility_office_work WHERE work_id = #{workId} AND use_yn = 'y'

WITH p AS ( INSERT INTO map.facility_office_work_photo ( work_id, kind, file_name, mime_type, file_size, content ) VALUES ( #{workId}, #{kind}, #{fileName}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{content, jdbcType=BINARY} ) RETURNING photo_id, work_id, kind, file_name, mime_type, file_size, reg_date ) SELECT ::text FROM p

SELECT json_build_object( 'workId', #{workId}, 'items', COALESCE(json_agg( json_build_object( 'photo_id', p.photo_id, 'kind', p.kind, 'file_name', p.file_name, 'mime_type', p.mime_type, 'file_size', p.file_size, 'reg_date', to_char(p.reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ) ORDER BY CASE p.kind WHEN 'BEFORE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.photo_id ), '[]'::json) )::text FROM map.facility_office_work_photo p WHERE p.work_id = #{workId} AND p.use_yn = 'y'

SELECT p.file_name, p.mime_type, p.content FROM map.facility_office_work_photo p JOIN map.facility_office_work w ON w.work_id = p.work_id AND w.use_yn = 'y' WHERE p.photo_id = #{photoId} AND p.work_id = #{workId} AND p.use_yn = 'y'
mapper.update: UPDATE map.facility_office_work_photo p SET use_yn = 'n' FROM map.facility_office_work w WHERE p.photo_id = #{photoId} AND p.work_id = #{workId} AND p.use_yn = 'y' AND w.work_id = p.work_id AND w.use_yn = 'y'
